professional_bio: Priya Menon is a Business Analyst specializing in operations-focused consulting environments. With an MBA in Operations and Finance and a B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering, she combines strong analytical skills with technical proficiency in SQL, Power BI, Excel, and Python. Priya has experience in developing and standardizing reporting templates, building interactive dashboards, and coordinating with stakeholders to drive process improvements and data-driven decision-making. She is also skilled in mentoring junior analysts, ensuring quality and consistency in reporting outputs.

My approach emphasizes clear stakeholder communication, thorough documentation, and continuous process improvement. Hi, I'm Priya Menon - Business Analyst specializing in operations and reporting. I help consulting teams transform data into actionable insights through effective dashboards and process improvements.

My expertise lies in SQL-based analysis, Power BI dashboard development, and stakeholder collaboration to enhance operational efficiency.

- SQL, Power BI, Excel, Python
- Process Mapping & Documentation
- Stakeholder Management & Communication
- Reporting Consistency & Dashboard Development

Operations Analyst supporting reporting and process coordination for operations teams. Led initiatives to standardize reporting formats and mentor junior analysts.

- Improved reporting consistency across teams by standardizing tracker formats.
- Mentored junior analysts to enhance dashboard maintenance and reporting quality.

### Education
- MBA in Operations and Finance, Cochin Management Institute, 2023
- B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering, 2021

### Certifications
- Power BI Fundamentals
- Microsoft Excel for Business

### Contact
Connect with me via my portfolio website or GitHub for project collaborations and opportunities.
